thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: Khoi dong Excel tu Start, chon Blank workbook, File > Save As de dat ten va chon thu muc luu.
Buoc 2: Hieu o (Cell) la giao cot (chu cai) va hang (so); quan sat Name Box de biet dia chi o.
Buoc 3: Nhap 4 kieu du lieu: chuoi (Ho ten), ngay thang (thang/ngay/nam), so (diem), cong thuc (bat dau bang =). Ket thuc bang Enter.
Buoc 4: Dieu chinh do rong cot, chieu cao hang bang keo hoac double-click AutoFit.
Buoc 5: Chen/xoa cot va hang bang chuot phai > Insert/Delete; di chuyen bang keo khi co 4 mui ten, giu Shift+keo de chen.
Buoc 6: Them sheet bang dau +, doi ten bang double-click/Rename, copy bang Ctrl+keo, sap xep bang keo tab, xoa bang Delete, to mau bang Tab Color.
Buoc 7: Dat ten vung qua Name Box de quan ly; File > Save de luu, Save As de tao ban moi, mo lai tu Recent hoac Browse.
